topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found out today that my partner has been writing a novel about me. It’s tucked away in a folder on their computer, pages and pages of words, all about our life together. Part of me is thrilled, thinking it’s a beautiful testament to our relationship. But there’s also this cautious part, wondering how much of our private moments are on those pages. What if others read it? I’m not sure how I feel about being a character in someone else’s story. I suppose I’ll need to talk to them, find out more about what this means for us. It’s a lot to process, and I want to approach this conversation with care, to understand where they’re coming from and share my thoughts honestly.
